events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled "The Beatles" but widely known as the "White Album," on November 2, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles dropped their iconic "White Album". Double album, double the genius. Which track is still on repeat for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost one of music's most incredible voices. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose legacy continues to rock the world.
